name: Dominance Defect
definition: For a finite nonempty binary class $C$, set $d_{\rm dom}(C)=0$ when the separator coefficient ratio satisfies $\tau(C)=0$, and set $d_{\rm dom}(C)=1$ otherwise.
normalization: Only nonempty classes are assigned a value.
comments: The definition extends to every finite nonempty binary class. It records membership in the strict-dominance family and deliberately discards positive values of $\tau$.
